task: Add a guard so quorum_submit refuses to re-submit a verdict quorum for a runId that already has a verdict at the same materialDigest, while still allowing a fresh quorum after the material changes.
outcome: Running quorum_submit a second time for the same story at the same material prints `quorum_submit refuses: verdicts already exist for runId(s) B-xxxx-q-r1, B-xxxx-q-r2, B-xxxx-q-r3 at the current material; re-submitting would duplicate the quorum` and exits non-zero, writing zero new verdict files and zero new host_verdict events; after a real material change (new commit) the same call succeeds and emits a fresh rounds x 2 quorum.
facts: quorum_submit generates deterministic runIds storyId-q-rN and emits verdicts via submitLocalVerdict in a loop (quorum-submit.ts).
listVerdicts(root,'local',storyId) returns all HostVerdicts (each has runId + materialDigest).
summarizeVerdicts already counts duplicateVerdicts but the handler never checks before emitting.
The existing smoke rounds-knob case re-submits overlapping runIds at the same material and so currently exercises the duplication.
constraints: Only modify the quorum_submit handler + its smoke test.
No behavior change for the first/legitimate quorum submission.
Refusal must write no verdicts and no host_verdict process events.
unknowns: None blocking — guard keys on (runId, materialDigest); placement is after materialDigest is computed.
